Description: Community Partners International empowers vulnerable communities in Asia to meet their essential health, humanitarian, and sustainable development needs. We focus on communities affected by conflict, violence, and displacement in remote and hard-to-reach contexts and marginalized through poverty and exclusion. We believe the best way to achieve and sustain positive change is to empower people to do it themselves. We build strong, long-term partnerships with the communities we serve and a deep understanding of local contexts. We partner with communities to meet their immediate needs and build resilient systems that will serve them long into the future.
